profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at The Home Depot
profile.summary:
•	12+ years IT Experience including all phases of Software Engineering such as SDLC (Analysis Design, Development, Testing and Maintenance) of business intelligence applications.
•	11+ years experience working in Finance Industries
•	Designed and developed microservices with spring boot. 
•	Complete understanding of 3 tier Architecture enterprise application using Java, J2ee, Html 5, Flex. 
•	Worked on Enterprise level application using HTML5, ReactJS, Redux, Ext-JS(4,5), Flex, JSON, Node.js, Ajax, Java, J2ee technologies, Spring Boot.
•	Expert in creating large scale SPA in ReactJS using react-router and ES6 with experience developing single - page applications (SPAs).
•	Experience in using React JS components, Forms, Events, Keys, Router, Parent and child components communication.
•	Experienced in React.js for creating interactive UI's using State, ref, React Hooks, One-way data flow, Virtual DOM, JSX, React Native concepts.
•	Detail understanding of components like ag-grid, list, dropdown, sorting, filtering in ReactJs.
•	Maintained Unit Test code coverage by writing testcases using Jasmine, Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress and have used Mockito for JUnit.
•	Extensive hands on and progressive experience in various Technologies like Web Services, XML, CSS, HTML, Ajax, JavaScript, IIS, Apache server.
•	Extensively worked on Spring Framework technologies, such as Spring MVC, AOP, POJOs, JDBC, JPA.
•	Hands on experience working on Core Java, Collection API, Streams, JDBC, JSP, Servlets, spring, MVC, AOP, Hibernate, Struts.
•	Expertise in manipulating database using SQL, functions, Triggers, Views, Transaction Management, Cursors and Stored Procedures.
•	Experience with Design Patterns which include MVC, Singleton, DAO, Factory, Inversion of control (IOC), AOP.
•	Worked on Swagger API and auto-generated documentation for all REST calls
•	Worked on CI/CD using Jenkins for building and deploying the application.
•	Improved performance of applications using chrome and Firefox debugging and profiling tools.
•	An enthusiastic and goal-oriented team player possessing excellent communication, interpersonal skills and leadership capabilities with high level of adaptability.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Work with cross-functional teams, inspire and guide a team of developers to meet project goals and deliver high-quality software solutions.
•	Work closely with product managers, designers, QA teams, and other departments to ensure alignment on project requirements and timelines.
•	Engage with clients or upper management to understand requirements, manage expectations, and provide regular project updates.
•	Identify inefficiencies in team workflows and propose solutions to improve productivity, deployment strategy, collaboration, and quality.
•	Establish and enforce clear documentation practices to ensure that all code, architectures, and processes are well-documented for future reference.
•	Mentored and coached junior developers, providing pair programming resulting in their improvement in team productivity and individual performance.
•	Guide the design and architecture of software solutions, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and performance. 
•	Create inclusive and fun work environment where all engineers engage effectively.
•	Stay updated with emerging technologies and recommend improvements or innovations that enhance the team’s capabilities and the product’s success.
•	Identify potential risks or roadblocks in the development process and take proactive steps to mitigate them.
